scripts.radio:
Karibu kwenye Jua Kesho, mimi ni Jua. Today, let's talk money, promises, and what's coming our way before 2027.

First - HELB. Many young Kenyans forget: HELB is a loan, not a gift from government. When you default, it's recoverable debt, and CRB doesn't play - you end up blacklisted, locked out of future credit, even a simple loan for business.

Now here's the irony. President Ruto promised that no student would miss university for lack of fees. That promise is only partly kept. The new funding model has actually locked many students out, still waiting, still applying, still stuck outside lecture halls.

And speaking of money owed - the state itself owes Kenya Power Sh7.35 billion. Meanwhile, ordinary Kenyans using tokens never miss a payment, rain or shine. Something doesn't add up there.

Before we close, remember - 2027 is closer than you think. Five things are moving right now: Election Day is fixed for August 10, 2027. Voter registration is ongoing - go check your status. IEBC is reviewing boundaries that could change your ward. Tax direction for next year gets decided in February, not June. And political coalitions forming now must register before the vote.

Stay informed, stay sharp. This is Jua, keeping you ready for Kesho.

Kwa Kiswahili haraka haraka: HELB ni mkopo, si zawadi - ukikosa kulipa utaingia CRB. Ahadi ya Ruto ya masomo bila ada bado haijatimia kikamilifu. Serikali inadaiwa Kenya Power bilioni 7.35 wakati wananchi wanalipa token kwa wakati. Na 2027 iko karibu - hakikisha umejiandikisha kupiga kura.
scripts.voice_note:
Hey, quick one from Jua Kesho. Let's talk about HELB for a second. A lot of us think it's free money from government - it's not. It's recoverable debt. If you default, you land straight on the CRB blacklist, and that follows you - when you want a business loan, even a simple phone loan, it's there.

Then there's the President's promise that no student would miss university over fees. That's only partly kept. The new funding model has actually locked many students out, still waiting on their allocations.

One more thing - 2027 is closer than it feels. Voter registration is open, boundary review could shift your ward, and next year's tax direction gets decided in February, not June.

Stay sharp, stay ready. This is Jua - talk soon.
